modules.title: Profile 怎样隔离两套连接配置

items.title: 给配置组起名字
items.text: Provider、Base URL、模型和权限等相关参数可以被保存为一个命名组合。

items.title: 启动时选择一组
items.text: 启动工具时明确指定 Profile，客户端就按该组参数建立当前会话。

items.title: 减少手动改错
items.text: 公司和个人连接各自保存，能减少忘记切换地址或账户后把代码发错地方的风险。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: Profile 不是工作区、Git 分支或 Session。它只切换 AI 工具使用的连接参数，不会改变本地文件、提交历史或对话上下文。

lessonPractice.title: 为了避免把敏感项目请求发到公网，使用 Profile 时哪项做法更安全？

options.label: 在敏感项目目录启动工具时明确指定隔离的内网 Profile
options.feedback: 对。显式选择 Profile 能让当前会话加载预期的 Provider 和地址，减少误用默认配置的风险。

options.label: 把公司和个人密钥都放进同一个 default Profile，启动时最省事
options.feedback: 共享默认配置容易在敏感项目中误用个人或公网连接，不能提供隔离。

options.label: 切换 Profile 就等于切换 Git 分支，因此不需要确认网络地址
options.feedback: Profile 只切换 AI 连接参数，不会切换代码分支，也不能替代对 Provider 和 Base URL 的检查。

en.title: Which Profile workflow is safer for keeping sensitive project requests off public endpoints?

options.label: Explicitly select an isolated intranet Profile when starting the tool in the sensitive project
options.feedback: Correct. An explicit Profile loads the expected Provider and endpoint and reduces accidental use of a default configuration.

options.label: Put both company and personal keys in one default Profile for convenience
options.feedback: A shared default can route sensitive work through the wrong personal or public connection and does not isolate it.

options.label: Treat switching a Profile as switching a Git branch, so endpoint checks are unnecessary
options.feedback: A Profile changes AI connection settings, not code branches, and does not replace checking the Provider and Base URL.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请帮我检查 work 和 personal 两个 Profile 的 Provider、Base URL 与密钥变量名是否隔离。不要读取密钥值，也不要修改 Git 分支；给出启动时如何明确选择 Profile 的命令。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Check that the work and personal profiles use separate Providers, Base URLs, and key variable names. Do not read key values or change Git branches; show how to select a profile explicitly at startup.

learning.assumes: You need to switch an AI tool between more than one project or account.
learning.outcome: You can isolate connection settings with named profiles and distinguish them from workspaces and branches.

modules.title: How does a Profile isolate two connection settings?

items.title: It names a settings group
items.text: Related Provider, Base URL, model, and permission settings can be saved as one named combination.

items.title: Select one at startup
items.text: When the tool starts with an explicit profile, the client initializes the session from that group.

items.title: It reduces manual switching errors
items.text: Separate work and personal connections reduce the chance of sending code through the wrong endpoint.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: A Profile is not a workspace, Git branch, or Session. It changes the AI client's connection settings, not local files, commit history, or conversation context.

distinctions.label: Configuration File
distinctions.text: A {c:config-file} is the physical file on disk; a {c:profile} is a named preset group defined within configurations for quick context switching.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: Check that the work and personal profiles use separate Providers, Base URLs, and key variable names. Do not read key values or change Git branches; show how to select a profile explicitly at startup.
